about_the_game:
Meal Quest is an educational action rogue-like where you’ll play as Pineapple, whose fridge opens to a realm where magic exists, and the sweets hold the Recipe of Health. As your new friend Tomato gets infected, you’ll traverse through different biomes fighting rebellious fruits, viruses, and sweets to reach Dream City and find the cure for your friend.

EAT YOUR WAY TO VICTORY

In Meal Quest, plan meals during the day, strategically buying food items to reach daily vitamin goals. At night, a portal in the fridge opens, where your nutrition choices grant you combat bonuses that reflect what vitamins do in the real world. Build habits that strengthen both your character and your real-world self.

YOUR OWN FLAVOR OF COMBAT

Between fights, collect vitamin upgrades, mix weapon traits, and forge your own playstyle for every run. Unleash magic spells, set electric traps, or fire explosive bullets – your diet and build choices decide how close you get to the Recipe of Health.
